dict.string: Velon uses the camera when you choose to capture a fresh photo for a custom city cover or a visit taste note. Photos stay in your on-device food-trip notebook so you can remember dishes, street stalls, and bakery counters from each tasting day. Camera access is optional and only used for the image you decide to attach.

Velon accesses your photo library when you pick an existing picture as a custom city cover or as an optional photo for a visit taste note. Selected images are copied into the app documents folder on this device to illustrate your routes and digest album cards. Library access is requested only when you tap upload or attach photo.

Velon may use the microphone if you record a short video memory with sound for a visit note or city cover using the camera. Audio is captured only as part of that optional media attachment for your personal tasting notebook and is stored on this device with the related note.

Velon may request permission to use the App Tracking Transparency framework so diagnostic signals about how you browse curated food cities, arrange tasting routes, and open digest previews can be measured in aggregate. This helps us understand which planning flows are confusing and improve reliability of preference matching and album generation. Velon does not use this permission to show advertising. You can allow or deny tracking and continue planning food trips either way. Data considered under this prompt may include coarse interaction patterns inside Velon, not your private visit note text or photos unless you separately share them.
